label.zh: 行为目标与全身控制接口

description.zh: 把期望行为转化为物理反馈控制：区分密集参考跟踪、分布与距离场先验、掩码目标补全、技能潜空间、零样本奖励表示与低层动作参数化。
description.en: Turn desired behavior into physical feedback control across dense tracking, motion priors, goal completion, skill latents, zero-shot reward representations, and action parameterizations.

focus.zh: 先看输入给控制器的是逐帧参考、稀疏目标、技能编码还是奖励向量，再看物理反馈发生在哪一层。
focus.en: Identify whether the controller receives dense frames, sparse goals, skill codes, or reward vectors, and locate where physical feedback acts.

label.zh: 密集参考跟踪与能力整合

description.zh: 逐帧或短窗参考指定时变目标，跟踪器提供闭环抗扰与跌倒恢复；多专家蒸馏或大规模单策略训练扩展动作覆盖面。
description.en: Dense or short-window references specify time-varying targets while trackers maintain balance and recovery; distillation or large-scale training expands coverage.

focus.zh: 动作规模扩大时，靠专家渐进扩增、共享运动编码器，还是课程与采样重加权解决长尾困难片段？
focus.en: As motion scale grows, does coverage come from progressive specialists, shared encoders, or curriculum and adaptive sampling?

label.zh: 分布匹配与模仿奖励先验

description.zh: 无需严格逐帧对齐时，用判别器、差分判别、扩散 score 或距离场把人类示范转化为训练期正则与奖励信号。
description.en: When strict frame alignment is unnecessary, discriminators, differential discriminators, diffusion scores, or distance fields turn demonstrations into training rewards.

focus.zh: 训练期谁提供自然性梯度？部署期判别器或先验网络是否完全卸下？任务奖励与风格奖励冲突时如何平衡？
focus.en: Which module supplies naturalness signals during training, what remains at deployment, and how are task–style conflicts resolved?

label.zh: 稀疏目标补全与多模态控制接口

description.zh: 统一处理 VR 头手稀疏目标、局部关节掩码、根速度命令或关键帧约束，在欠定目标下补全协调的全身动作。
description.en: Unify sparse VR head-hand targets, joint masks, root commands, or keyframes, completing coordinated whole-body motion from under-specified goals.

focus.zh: 面对多模态欠定目标，靠条件变分编码器采样、Transformer 掩码重建，还是统一中间运动学接口？
focus.en: Are under-specified goals resolved through conditional VAEs, masked Transformers, or unified kinematic interfaces?

label.zh: 技能潜空间与分层运动原语
label.en: Skill latent spaces & hierarchical motor primitives

description.zh: 将复杂运动压缩为连续高斯潜空间、球面嵌入、离散 FSQ token 或可组合上下肢原语，供高层策略或规划器按步调用。
description.en: Compress motor repertoire into Gaussian latents, hyperspherical embeddings, discrete FSQ tokens, or composable primitives callable by high-level policies.

focus.zh: 潜变量由互信息发现、跟踪教师蒸馏，还是自回归生成先验学习？高层改写潜变量时低层动力学是否平滑过渡？
focus.en: Are latents learned via mutual-information discovery, teacher distillation, or generative priors, and do transitions stay dynamically smooth?

label.zh: 零样本奖励表示与后继特征

description.zh: 预训练长期状态访问表示（FB、FB-CPR、时间距离或双曲对比评价），推理期仅把新奖励或目标映射为任务向量即可零样本切换行为。
description.en: Pretrain long-term occupancy, successor, or temporal-distance representations so new rewards or goals map directly to task vectors without RL retraining.

focus.zh: 无奖励预训练怎样防止潜空间坍缩并贴合自然人体流形？面对非马尔可夫奖励或动力学偏移时线性内积假设在哪里失效？
focus.en: How does reward-free pretraining avoid collapse and stay near natural motion manifolds, and where does linear reward projection break?

label.zh: 低层动作参数化与连续控制律
label.en: Low-level action parameterization & continuous control laws

description.zh: 比较关节位置 PD、直接力矩输出、周期轨迹发生器调制（PMTG）、ODE/样条连续动作流及动作块动态执行步长（DEHP）。
description.en: Compare joint-position PD, direct torque control, trajectory-generator modulation (PMTG), ODE/spline continuous action laws, and dynamic chunk execution horizons.

focus.zh: 时间平滑性与高频抗扰来自低层 PD 刚度、轨迹发生器相位先验、连续曲线流反馈，还是自适应重规划时机？
focus.en: Does smoothness and disturbance rejection come from low-level PD stiffness, phase generators, continuous curve feedback, or adaptive replanning?

label.zh: 生成式运动先验与闭环轨迹合成
label.en: Generative motion priors & closed-loop trajectory synthesis

description.zh: 以扩散或流匹配合成状态条件化的参考动作块（BeyondMimic、Heracles、UniPhys、RobotMDM），或用测试时引导对齐下游物理跟踪。
description.en: Synthesize state-conditioned motion chunks via diffusion or flow matching (BeyondMimic, Heracles, UniPhys, RobotMDM), aligning generation with closed-loop tracking.

focus.zh: 生成模型直接输出关节动作，还是产出短窗参考交由跟踪器执行？推理期引导与离线价值微调怎样消除物理不可行动作？
focus.en: Does the generator emit raw joint actions or short references for a tracker, and how do test-time guidance or critic finetuning prune infeasible motions?

label.zh: 几何、接触与物理可行性

description.zh: 跨越人体与机器人的自由度、连杆比例与质量分布差异，构建运动学合理、接触一致、满足安全与柔顺约束的可执行运动。
description.en: Bridge human–robot kinematic, inertial, and contact mismatches to produce physically feasible, contact-consistent, and compliant robot motion.

focus.zh: 区分三个层次：几何姿态像不像、接触时序与力矩通不通、执行偏离时硬约束还是柔顺让位。
focus.en: Separate geometric pose similarity, contact-force feasibility, and whether runtime controllers enforce hard bounds or compliant yielding.

label.zh: 运动学到动力学重定向

description.zh: 从逐帧 IK、统一骨骼映射，推进到混合整数/多重打靶动力学优化、仿真 rollout 搜索与 RL 修复蒸馏的神经重定向器。
description.en: Progress from per-frame IK and unified skeletal mapping to kinodynamic optimization, rollout refinement, and RL-repaired neural retargeters.

focus.zh: 优化变量是关节角、接触力与力矩，还是摊销重定向网络参数？物理可行性在离线参考阶段解决到什么程度最划算？
focus.en: Are variables joint angles, contact wrenches, or amortized network weights, and how much feasibility should be solved before RL tracking?

label.zh: 交互网格、接触结构与时序

description.zh: 用交互网格、有符号距离场、表面力学锚点、顺序接触阶段或隐式接触参数化，保留身体—环境与手—物体的关键接触拓扑。
description.en: Preserve body–scene and hand–object contact topology via interaction meshes, distance fields, mechanics-aware anchors, sequential stages, or implicit contact geometry.

focus.zh: 接触表示作为重定向约束、跟踪奖励、阶段切换条件，还是可微冲量求解器的几何先验？
focus.en: Does the contact representation serve as a retargeting constraint, tracking reward, stage switch, or differentiable solver geometry?

label.zh: 安全约束、平滑度与柔顺控制

description.zh: 通过控制屏障函数 QP、几何织物、最小干预反馈、Lipschitz/Jacobian 正则与事后扰动柔顺训练，控制出力边界与交互刚度。
description.en: Regulate force limits, smoothness, and interaction stiffness via CBF-QPs, geometric fabrics, minimal-intervention feedback, Jacobian penalties, and compliance training.

focus.zh: 安全与柔顺靠优化层投影硬保证、策略网络平滑度约束，还是训练期扰动重构的隐式阻抗？
focus.en: Is safety or compliance achieved via QP projection, policy Jacobian regularization, or hindsight-perturbed implicit impedance?

label.zh: 部分可观、感知融合与特权蒸馏

description.zh: 真实部署缺少仿真真值与完整地形/物体状态：用显式滤波、本体历史表征、多模态外感受编码与师生训练补齐信息鸿沟。
description.en: Real robots lack simulator ground truth: bridge information gaps with invariant filters, proprioceptive history latents, multimodal perception, and teacher–student training.

focus.zh: 部署期缺失的是物理状态、局部几何地图，还是仅服务训练探索的特权脚手架？学生误差能否反过来约束教师？
focus.en: Is the missing signal physical state, local geometry, or a training-only scaffold—and can student limitations reshape the teacher?

label.zh: 状态估计与本体历史表征

description.zh: 对比 Lie 群不变滤波与从本体历史端到端推断速度、地形响应或动力学上下文的重建式、对比式及自回归潜表征。
description.en: Compare Lie-group invariant filtering against end-to-end history encoders learning velocity and context via reconstruction, contrastive prototypes, or predictive losses.

focus.zh: 历史编码器靠变分重建下一观测、SwAV 原型对比，还是纯下一步潜预测即可在无特权教师下跑通？
focus.en: Does history encoding rely on variational reconstruction, prototype contrast, or self-supervised latent prediction without privileged teachers?

label.zh: 视觉、触觉与局部地图编码

description.zh: 从深度图、RGB、高程栅格、点云对应或触觉图网络中提取与落脚点、抓握接触和避障直接耦合的控制表征。
description.en: Extract control-relevant features for footholds, grasping, and obstacle negotiation from depth, RGB, elevation maps, 3D correspondences, or tactile graphs.

focus.zh: 注意力选点、隐显式联合预测、三维几何对应与纯本体盲操边界分别在什么任务条件下占优？
focus.en: When do map attention, implicit-explicit terrain prediction, 3D correspondence, or pure proprioceptive active sensing prevail?

label.zh: 特权信息架构与师生对齐

description.zh: 系统比较两阶段 DAgger、并发师生共享 actor、学生感知反哺教师（SITT）、变分特权脚手架（VPIES）与特权噪声正则。
description.en: Compare two-stage DAgger, concurrent shared actors, student-informed teachers (SITT), variational privileged scaffolds (VPIES), and privileged dropout.

focus.zh: 当特权教师依赖学生永远观测不到的信息采取激进动作时，怎样消除不可模仿性与分布漂移？
focus.en: When an oracle teacher exploits unobservable cues, how do concurrent training, bottlenecks, or teacher penalties prevent unimitability?

label.zh: 动力学鸿沟、鲁棒控制与在线适应
label.en: Dynamics gaps, robust control & online adaptation

description.zh: 面向执行器非线性、接触失配、形态变化与长时磨损，协调离线系统辨识、训练期鲁棒覆盖与部署期在线上下文/残差适应。
description.en: Counter actuator nonlinearities, contact mismatch, morphology shifts, and wear via offline calibration, robust training, and online latent or residual adaptation.

focus.zh: 先分清修正发生在哪：校准仿真物理与电机模型、收紧最坏扰动增益、在线推断潜上下文，还是真实交互更新残差权重？
focus.en: Clarify where correction happens: calibrating sim/actuators, bounding worst-case disturbance gain, inferring online context, or updating residual weights.

label.zh: 系统辨识、电机与残差物理校准

description.zh: 用真实轨迹激励、分布匹配、无监督电机网络、接触一致初值重建、Delta-Action 动作残差或同伦 ODE 拟合对齐仿真与硬件。
description.en: Align simulation and hardware via active excitation, distributional CMA-ES, actuator networks, contact-consistent state init, delta-action models, or homotopy ODEs.

focus.zh: 真实轨迹采样是否充分激励可辨识参数？校准误差归入物理参数、电机力矩映射，还是动作空间残差模型？
focus.en: Do real rollouts excite identifiable parameters, and should mismatch be absorbed by physical parameters, torque maps, or delta-action residuals?

label.zh: 域随机化、鲁棒控制与跨形态泛化

description.zh: 研究关键随机化变量筛选、H∞ 对抗扰动博弈、群等变对称性偏置、简化到全身同伦延续（MHIT）与跨构型人形泛化。
description.en: Study critical randomization factors, H-infinity adversarial games, equivariant symmetry priors, simplified-to-full homotopy transfer, and morphology generalization.

focus.zh: 盲目扩大随机化何时导致保守策略？对称群偏置、最坏扰动界与动力学延续路径怎样降低鲁棒代价？
focus.en: When does wide randomization induce overly conservative policies, and how do equivariance, H-infinity bounds, or homotopy continuation help?

label.zh: 在线潜适应、残差修正与测试时对齐
label.en: Online latent adaptation, residuals & test-time alignment

description.zh: 比较固定权重的在线环境编码器（RMA/Belief-FB/CMoE）、受限动作残差策略与冻结世界模型/控制器的测试时轻量参数适应。
description.en: Compare fixed-weight online context inference (RMA, Belief-FB, CMoE), bounded action residuals, and test-time lightweight adaptation on frozen models.

focus.zh: 适应信号来自本体预测误差、奖励/价值梯度，还是人类在线干预？零初始化与范数约束如何守住基座安全？
focus.en: Does adaptation use prediction error, value gradients, or human intervention, and how do zero-init or norm bounds preserve base safety?

label.zh: 世界模型、可微物理与决策计算
label.en: World models, differentiable physics & decision computation

description.zh: 围绕四条主线组织模型驱动控制：模型目标与导数保真度、从模型到决策的优化路径、长时域梯度/搜索结构，以及连续时间与混杂模式。
description.en: Organize model-based control along four axes: model/gradient fidelity, decision optimization pathways, long-horizon rollout/credit structure, and time or hybrid modes.

focus.zh: 区分单步预测准、价值估计准与动作反传导数准；明确每次更新的是在线动作序列、摊销 actor 权重，还是测试时命令/残差。
focus.en: Distinguish state-prediction, value, and Jacobian accuracy; clarify whether updates target online actions, amortized actor weights, or test-time commands/residuals.

label.zh: W1 · 表征目标、价值一致性与导数保真度
label.en: W1 · Representation objectives, value consistency & derivative fidelity

description.zh: 比较像素/潜状态重建、无解码器 TD/JEPA 一致性、价值感知模型损失（VAML）与一阶导数/有限差分梯度监督（Sobolev、DDPPO、TaSIL）。
description.en: Compare reconstruction, decoder-free TD/JEPA consistency, value-aware losses (VAML), and Jacobian or finite-difference supervision (Sobolev, DDPPO, TaSIL).

focus.zh: 下游做采样 MPC、想象轨迹价值估计，还是解析反传更新策略时，世界模型各自最怕哪类局部误差？
focus.en: Which local model errors are fatal for sampling MPC, imagined value expansion, versus analytical backpropagation policy updates?

label.zh: W2 · 在线规划、想象反传与测试时优化
label.en: W2 · Online planning, imagined backprop & test-time optimization

description.zh: 统一对照在线采样/梯度 MPC（TD-MPC2、PL-MPC）、潜世界模型想象训练（DreamerV3、PWM、SuperMimic）、可微物理伴随更新（∇Mimic）与推理时优化（ITPO、TTCO）。
description.en: Contrast online MPC (TD-MPC2, PL-MPC), latent imagination actor-critics (DreamerV3, PWM, SuperMimic), differentiable physics (∇Mimic), and test-time optimization (ITPO, TTCO).

focus.zh: 动作梯度来自 Q 函数、学习世界模型还是可微刚体仿真？在线规划结果怎样闭环蒸馏回策略与价值网络？
focus.en: Do action gradients come from Q critics, learned world models, or differentiable simulators, and how does online planning close the loop back to learning?

label.zh: W3 · 动态展开时域、并行打靶与分层规划
label.en: W3 · Dynamic horizons, parallel shooting & hierarchical planning

description.zh: 针对长时域复合误差与接触梯度爆炸，研究接触自适应截断（AHAC）、不确定性动态时域（DMVE）、动作块展开（CMPO）、虚拟状态并行规划（GRASP）与子目标/后继分解（ID-WM、BeJEPA）。
description.en: Tame compounding error and stiff contact gradients via contact-adaptive horizons (AHAC), dynamic value expansion (DMVE), chunk rollouts (CMPO), parallel shooting (GRASP), and hierarchical decomposition (ID-WM, BeJEPA).

focus.zh: 面对刚性接触或长视距任务，应该动态截断反传步数、直接跨步预测动作块、引入虚拟状态打靶，还是用后继特征/双曲几何拆分子目标？
focus.en: Should stiff contacts and long horizons be handled by adaptive truncation, direct multi-step chunks, virtual-state shooting, or subgoal/successor decomposition?

label.zh: W4 · 连续时间、可变步长与混杂动力学模式
label.en: W4 · Continuous time, variable intervals & hybrid modes

description.zh: 建模可变控制周期（TAWM）、可变动作块执行步长（DEHP）、观测延迟 Laplace 表征、事件零点/点过程触发，以及离散—连续混杂模式路由（NHA、DHAL、MoRE）。
description.en: Model variable control steps (TAWM), dynamic chunk execution horizons (DEHP), delayed Laplace history, event-triggered jumps, and discrete-continuous hybrid routing (NHA, DHAL, MoRE).

focus.zh: 时间变量是输入采样间隔、动作块持续步数，还是碰撞事件触发时刻？离散模式由门控专家路由、状态零点还是等待时间分布决定？
focus.en: Is time the step interval, chunk execution duration, or impact instant, and are modes governed by expert routing, zero-crossings, or waiting-time densities?

label.zh: 经验采集、示范扩展与策略自改进
label.en: Experience pipelines, demonstration scaling & policy post-training

description.zh: 研究经验从哪里来、怎样放大覆盖，以及如何从离线模仿平滑过渡到在线 RL 探索、优势条件化自改进与真机微调。
description.en: Study how robot experience is collected and synthesized, and how offline imitation transitions into online RL exploration, advantage-conditioned self-improvement, and real-world finetuning.

focus.zh: 数据瓶颈卡在遥操作接口、互联网视频物理清洗，还是示范分布外的探索崩溃与价值高估？
focus.en: Is the bottleneck teleop throughput, physics verification of wild video, or out-of-distribution collapse and critic overestimation during RL post-training?

label.zh: 遥操作、人体视频管线与数据合成扩增

description.zh: 涵盖全身外骨骼/VR 遥操作、单目视频三维全局动作重建与百万级物理过滤（TRAM、Movens-5M）、物体中心示范合成（MimicGen）及多样重置状态生成（OmniReset）。
description.en: Cover whole-body/VR teleoperation, global 3D motion recovery and physics filtering at scale (TRAM, Movens-5M), object-centric trajectory synthesis (MimicGen), and reset generation (OmniReset).

focus.zh: 扩增的是同任务几何变换轨迹、跨视角海量自然人体先验，还是高信息量的接触起始状态分布？
focus.en: Does scaling expand object-centric pose variations, web-scale physics-verified human priors, or informative contact reset distributions?

label.zh: 从模仿预训练到 RL 探索与真机微调
label.en: From imitation pretraining to RL exploration & real-world finetuning

description.zh: 解决 BC 预训练接续 RL 时的分布偏移、多峰覆盖与样本效率：比较后验采样探索（Posterior BC）、优势条件回归（RECAP）、演示引导在线 RL 与人类纠错残差。
description.en: Bridge BC pretraining and RL finetuning via posterior exploration (Posterior BC), advantage-conditioned regression (RECAP), demo-guided RL (Rainbow-DemoRL), and online residual learning.

focus.zh: 继续学习时改写基座参数、条件化优势指标，还是冻结基座叠加小残差？如何避免初始随机探索毁掉预训练先验？
focus.en: Does post-training update base weights, condition on advantage indicators, or freeze the base with residuals without destroying pretrained priors?

label.zh: 多模态具身基座、VLA 与生成式世界动作模型
label.en: Multimodal embodied foundations, VLAs & world-action models

description.zh: 连接开放世界视觉语言语义、视频世界生成先验与跨构型高频控制，涵盖流匹配 VLA、联合预测未来视频与动作的 WAM，以及语言/视频驱动的全身运动生成基座。
description.en: Connect open-world vision-language semantics and generative video priors to continuous control across flow-matching VLAs, video world-action models (WAMs), and multimodal motion foundations.

focus.zh: 语义推理、未来视觉状态生成、全身参考轨迹合成与高频物理跟踪控制器在系统里如何切分接口与运行频率？
focus.en: How are semantic reasoning, future video prediction, reference motion generation, and high-frequency physical tracking partitioned across modules and rates?

label.zh: 视觉—语言—动作策略与语义操作

description.zh: 以 VLM 主干结合流匹配动作专家、异构协同预训练、高层子任务推理或三维可供性/工具几何推理，实现开放场景语义泛化。
description.en: Combine VLM backbones with flow-matching action experts, heterogeneous co-training, subtask reasoning, or 3D tool/affordance grounding for open-world manipulation.

focus.zh: 互联网图文知识与跨机器人连续动作专家怎样避免梯度相互干扰？离散语义推理与连续动作块如何解耦？
focus.en: How are web-scale VLM representations insulated from continuous action-expert gradients, and how do discrete subtasks guide continuous chunks?

label.zh: 视频世界—动作联合生成与多模态运动基座
label.en: Video world–action models & multimodal motion foundations

description.zh: 利用大规模视频扩散/流匹配基座联合建模未来视觉演变与动作（DreamZero、LDA-1B、GigaWorld），或从语言/视频生成物理可跟踪的全身动作流（Movens-Zero、Workhorse）。
description.en: Leverage video diffusion/flow backbones to jointly generate future visual states and actions (DreamZero, LDA-1B, GigaWorld), or synthesize physically trackable whole-body motions (Movens-Zero, Workhorse).

focus.zh: 未来视频生成仅作为训练期动力学正则、低频视觉子目标，还是经蒸馏与实时分块直接承担闭环控制？
focus.en: Does future video generation act as a training regularizer, low-frequency visual subgoal, or distilled real-time closed-loop policy?

label.zh: 算子学习、同伦数值求解与预条件

description.zh: 涵盖非线性算子逼近基石（DeepONet）、同伦预测—校正步长调度（NPC）与神经线性预条件算子（NPO），提供跨问题数值计算工具。
description.en: Cover nonlinear operator approximation (DeepONet), homotopy predictor–corrector scheduling (NPC), and neural linear preconditioning (NPO) as numerical foundations.

focus.zh: 区分函数空间算子映射、非线性同伦路径跟踪与病态线性系统预条件，明确迁入机器人轨迹优化或系统辨识所需的接口条件。
focus.en: Separate operator mapping, homotopy path tracking, and linear preconditioning, clarifying interface requirements before applying them to robot optimization.

label.zh: 稀疏注意力与序列推理效率

description.zh: LessIsMore 探索跨头共享稀疏注意力选择以降低自回归长序列解码带宽，为大型 VLA/WAM 实时推理提供潜在算力参考。
description.en: LessIsMore unifies sparse KV selection across attention heads to cut decoding memory bandwidth, offering a systems reference for large VLA/WAM inference.

focus.zh: 关注内存带宽瓶颈与稀疏筛选开销的真实硬件加速比，避免未经闭环验证直接外推到高频动作模型。
focus.en: Check real hardware latency versus memory-bandwidth savings before extrapolating LLM KV sparsity to closed-loop action models.

reason.zh: 海量遥操作、互联网人体视频与合成扩增提供多模态经验覆盖，支撑 VLA 与世界动作基座预训练；RECAP 等后训练又将真实交互反哺基座。
reason.en: Teleop, web human video, and synthetic pipelines supply multimodal coverage for VLA/WAM pretraining, while post-training feeds real rollouts back into foundation policies.

reason.zh: 高层语义、视频世界模型或运动生成基座输出稀疏目标、参考动作块或技能潜码，交由 K1 的全身反馈控制器闭环跟踪执行。
reason.en: High-level VLAs, WAMs, and motion generators emit sparse goals, motion chunks, or skill latents executed by K1 whole-body feedback controllers.

reason.zh: 单目人类视频和跨形态示范存在穿模、脚滑与比例失配，必须经过 K2 的几何/动力学重定向与接触锚点精修才能变成有效训练数据。
reason.en: Monocular human video and cross-embodiment demos contain penetration, foot skate, and proportion mismatch that require K2 retargeting and contact anchoring.

reason.zh: 动力学可行的参考轨迹降低跟踪器探索难度，而安全屏障 QP 与事后柔顺训练约束 K1 策略在偏差与接触下的出力边界。
reason.en: Dynamically feasible references ease tracker learning, while CBF-QPs and compliance training bound K1 controller forces under contact deviations.

reason.zh: 部署期状态估计、局部地形注意力与特权师生蒸馏决定 K1 策略在盲视或部分可观条件下实际能调用的反馈信息。
reason.en: State estimation, terrain map encoding, and privileged distillation determine the feedback signals actually available to K1 controllers at deployment.

reason.zh: 本体历史潜表征既补全不可观测速度，又在线编码摩擦/负载等动力学偏移；需把固定权重的上下文推断与参数级微调区分开。
reason.en: Proprioceptive history latents infer both unmeasured velocities and hidden friction/payload shifts, bridging state estimation and online adaptation.

reason.zh: 真实交互辨识与残差校准为世界模型和可微仿真提供可信物理先验，而测试时残差适应（如 Sandwich-Residuals）直接在冻结世界模型中修正动力学偏移。
reason.en: System identification and residual calibration ground world models in real physics, while test-time residual layers adapt frozen world models online.

reason.zh: 世界模型与可微仿真既能在线搜索动作或优化冻结 BFM 的输入命令（TTCO、BeJEPA），也能通过解析梯度训练高维跟踪策略（SuperMimic、∇Mimic）。

reason.zh: 接触隐式求解、多重打靶轨迹优化与接触自适应截断时域（DSMS、ContactNets、AHAC）直接服务物理重定向与刚性接触控制。
reason.en: Contact-implicit solvers, multiple-shooting optimization, and contact-adaptive horizons directly power dynamic retargeting and stiff-contact control.

reason.zh: 潜空间动力学一致性（JEPA/RSSM）与多步世界建模从状态控制延伸到高维视觉—动作联合生成，但预测未来视频不等同于执行在线规划。
